verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada runs a first-party 'services, fees and processing times' page that lists processing times per transaction type and channel: online incorporation takes 1 day, 4-hour express costs $100 extra, email or mail takes 10 days, amendments take 1 day and exemptions take 30 days. A founder can read the time for their specific transaction directly from the service. Missing for 10: evidence that the published times reflect current or live queue conditions rather than fixed service standards, and independent or hands-on corroboration that actual processing matches the published times.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: It will cost $200 and will take 1 day.
